A gazette copy can be the only copy of the principal or amendment text
Stakeholder comments or another body's recommendations on a draft (e.g. 'Recommendations of CEA' under Draft Regulation).
Public notice inviting comments, or a hearing/workshop notice, on a draft or a paper. Tried before staff papers: a 'PN' file listed under Staff Paper is the notice for the paper.
An addendum issued as an order under a regulation (e.g. 'Addendum (Order - date 14.01.2026)').

Draft suo motu order put out for comments (e.g. Orders/11-SM-2026-I.pdf). The taxonomy has no draft-order type: the instrument is a suo motu/general order (CERC-13) and 'draft' is its status, not its type.
The draft text itself, by its own name (a 'Draft CERC (...) Regulations' title with no other part named, a draft notification file).
'Draft Regulation' is a CERC website section holding drafts and their EM, SoR, notices and comments; the section is not the type
CERC 'Procedure' listing: procedures approved under a regulation, often issued as an order
Appendix, annexure or formats of a draft regulation.
Appendix or annexure of a regulation: part of the regulation's text. Under draft_reg it is part of the draft (cerc.draft-annexure).
Suo motu or general order: an SM case number or an L-1 regulatory file in an orders folder, or an order issued under a named regulation.
An amending regulation, by its own title or file name.
Consolidated text of a regulation (as amended): typed as the principal regulation.
The Regulations listing, after every named kind (SoR, gazette, procedure, amendment, annexure...) has been tried.
Order folders also hold corrigenda to orders; the taxonomy has no 'corrigendum to an order' type yet
Order on an interlocutory application, by its title ('IA No. ... in Appeal No. ...') or file name ('Order on IA 862 of 2026').
Judgment in an appeal, original petition or review petition, by its title or file name.
APTEL 'Judgments/Orders' listing mixes final judgments and IA orders

Only a hint: the 'NCT Letter' listing mixes MoP gazette notifications (MoP-08), MoP OMs (MoP-11), CEA letters (CEA-05) and CTUIL letters (CT-11). Files on ctuil.in are typed by the ctuil.nct-page.* hosted rules first.
Press releases and weekly news bulletins
Weekly news or information bulletin (listed under Press Release or Uncategorized).
Directions under s.11/s.107, by title.
Amendment of rules, by title.
Office order / OM constituting a committee, by title.
Scheme guidelines, by title.
Guidelines (and amendments to guidelines), by title.
A national framework or policy, by title.
'Scheme and services' listing with nothing more specific in the name.
Manual, guidelines, advisory or standard, by its name (e.g. What's New: 'Manual on Transmission Planning Criteria').
A published list of entities (e.g. 'Final List of eligible entities as per 11/SM/2026'): a register list.
Letter on compensation payable under a CERC order (Regulatory Section): correspondence.
Detailed procedure, by its name or the Procedure listing.
Minutes of CTUIL reallocation meetings
Status of bay allocation and margin (Annex B/C/D) and reallocation capacity declarations

Reallocation notice: declares the relinquished connectivity capacity (by substation/bay) offered or approved for reallocation, so it is a capacity margin declaration (CT-05). CT-04 (grant/revision) is accepted for an approved reallocation. Capacity declarations, formats and minutes on the same listing have their own rules, tried first.
'Reallocation Meetings' listing mixes notices, declarations, formats and minutes
CTUIL 'Updates' listing: advisories and notices to users (cyclone readiness, new forms live on NSWS).
Fallback for files on CTUIL's ISTS scheme page that no ctuil.nct-page.* rule recognises.
CEA guidelines hosted on Grid-India's site (issuer CEA).
Standard operating procedure (e.g. 'SoP for AWS calibration').
First Time Energization and Integration listing: procedures and requirements for first-time charging.
Flasher (home-page notice strip): a notice with nothing more specific in the name.
State commission SoR or EM, by its title (GERC lists them under Regulation (Current)).
State commission Regulations listing (current regulations and their amendments).
